description: Create, update, or archive a brand. action=create (admin only): name, and the workspace_id from whoami when the key is not already scoped to one workspace. Optional timezone and website_url. Pass confirm=true only after the user agrees. action=update (admin only): brand_id plus name, timezone, or website_url. Pass confirm=true only after the user agrees. action=archive (admin only): preview then confirm. Call without confirm to see the brand and what archiving does, show that to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the preview_id. Archiving removes the brand from the active list. Connected accounts stay connected, and its scheduled posts are not cancelled: they still publish. The preview counts both.

brand_id.description: update and archive: the brand ID from list_brands.

confirm.description: create and update: true only after the user agrees. archive: true only with the preview_id from a preview call.

name.description: create: required. update: the new name.

preview_id.description: archive: the preview_id from the preview call.

timezone.description: create or update: an IANA timezone such as Europe/London.

website_url.description: create or update: an http or https website. Pass an empty string on update to clear it.

workspace_id.description: create: workspace ID from whoami, when the key is not already scoped.

name: manage_brand
